title: BICEPS PROTOCOL — Build With Intent

creativeDirection.objective: Teach an effective biceps session using anatomical context, exercise technique and a practical prescription.
creativeDirection.audience: Spanish-speaking gym trainees with basic gym access.
creativeDirection.concept: Premium training film with anatomy motion graphics and three exercise demonstration plates.

visualSystem.typography: Bold editorial sans-serif with compact technical labels.
visualSystem.composition: Cinematic split compositions; motion graphics on right and explanatory copy on left.
visualSystem.lighting: Dark studio field, warm rim light and restrained orange highlights.
visualSystem.textureAndMaterials: Fine grain, blueprint grids, luminous anatomical strokes.

creativeDirection.motionLanguage: Camera drift, path reveals, animated joint arcs, rep-cycle cues and varied transitions.
creativeDirection.soundDirection: Spanish Kokoro narration above restrained original music, with localized impacts and transition sounds.
rightsAndFactualConstraints: Exercise figures are illustrative motion diagrams, not live-action footage.
Clearly distinguish biceps brachii, brachialis and brachioradialis.
Do not promise spot fat loss or guaranteed hypertrophy.
Emphasize controlled, pain-free technique and gradual progression.

shots.visual: Luminous arm blueprint assembles in dark studio.
shots.subject: Upper-arm outline
shots.action: Contours draw on as camera pushes forward.
shots.visualProgression: Outline emerges; muscle contour fills; labeled arm arrives.

shots.visual: Anatomical arm with callouts and forearm rotation cue.
shots.subject: Biceps brachii and brachialis
shots.action: Leader lines trace muscles; rotation arc animates.
shots.visualProgression: Full arm; muscle callouts; supination cue.

shots.visual: Side-view illustrated lifter and elbow-centered dumbbell arc.
shots.subject: Standing dumbbell curl
shots.action: Forearm rotates to supinated position as elbow flexes; controlled lowering.
shots.cameraMovement: Track dumbbell upward and ease downward.
shots.transition: Curl arc stretches into incline arm position.
shots.visualProgression: Arms extended; curl and supinate; slow eccentric return.

shots.purpose: Show curl with upper arm behind torso.
shots.visual: Incline bench silhouette and controlled curl.
shots.subject: Incline dumbbell curl
shots.action: Arms travel from stretched position while shoulder remains stable.
shots.visualProgression: Bench and extended arms; controlled curl; return without swing.

shots.visual: Close-up on neutral-grip dumbbells with anatomy overlay.
shots.subject: Hammer curl
shots.action: Dumbbells rise with palms inward and no wrist twist.
shots.transition: Dumbbell end cap match-cuts to program card.
shots.visualProgression: Neutral grip; elbow flexion; controlled return.

shots.visual: Three numbered movements resolve into concise training card.
shots.subject: Three-exercise biceps session
shots.action: Rows build in sequence and rest guidance settles.
shots.visualProgression: Three markers; set/rep prescription; final hold.

acceptanceCriteria: Six distinct chapters with purposeful motion.
Exercise depictions communicate joint action and grip.
Music beneath narration and mastered final mix.

acceptanceCoverage.rationale: The six-chapter composition is authored at 1920×1080 and 30 fps, with the closing card providing a stable final frame.
The voiceover is generated in Spanish with Kokoro and applied as word-aligned timed captions across all six chapters.

acceptanceCoverage.criterion: Six distinct chapters with purposeful motion.
acceptanceCoverage.rationale: Each chapter has its own visual plate, camera movement, animated overlays and transitions.

acceptanceCoverage.criterion: Exercise depictions communicate joint action and grip.
acceptanceCoverage.rationale: The three exercise plates show elbow flexion, the incline starting position and neutral hammer grip with wrist alignment.
All figures are custom vector illustrations and the production description explicitly states they are not live-action footage.

acceptanceCoverage.criterion: Music beneath narration and mastered final mix.
acceptanceCoverage.rationale: The original score is the sole music bed, ducked and mastered under the Spanish narration.
The final production workflow includes MP4 diagnostics, a contact sheet and render provenance before delivery.
